# IconGems

> Free search & download for 109,813+ open-source SVG icons from 29 famous libraries (Google Material Symbols, Microsoft Fluent, Tabler, Lucide, Phosphor, Font Awesome, Bootstrap, ByteDance IconPark…) plus 16 curated free illustration libraries. Bilingual EN/ZH. Built for designers, developers, PMs — and AI agents: every asset below is machine-readable, key-less and CORS-open.

## Quick start for agents

1. Pick a set from the catalog (check `license` first): https://icongems.kuige.me/data/catalog.json
2. Search: `GET https://api.iconify.design/search?query=<term>&prefixes=<prefix(es)>`
3. Get SVG: `GET https://api.iconify.design/<prefix>/<name>.svg?height=64` (`&color=%23hex` to recolor)
4. Ship: MIT/Apache/ISC/CC0 sets need no attribution; CC BY 4.0 sets do. Full details in llms-full.txt.

## Site

- [IconGems](https://icongems.kuige.me/): the human interface — aggregated search, one-click SVG/PNG download, copy-ready React/Vue/HTML/CSS
- [llms-full.txt](https://icongems.kuige.me/llms-full.txt): this guide with the complete catalog inlined

## Free illustration libraries (16, license per entry)

- [unDraw](https://undraw.co/): free, no attribution ⚠ no AI training — Consistent-style illustrations with live color customizer
- [Open Peeps](https://www.openpeeps.com/): CC0 — Hand-drawn people by Pablo Stanley
- [Humaaans](https://humaaans.com/): CC0 — Mix-and-match human characters
- [DiceBear](https://www.dicebear.com/): open source (per-style) — Avatar generator, dozens of styles
- [Storyset](https://storyset.com/): free with attribution (Freepik) — Editable animated illustrations
- [DrawKit](https://www.drawkit.com/): free with attribution (free tier) — Hand-drawn vector packs
- [ManyPixels](https://www.manypixels.co/gallery): free, no attribution — Monocolor gallery with color picker
- [3dicons](https://www.3dicons.com/): open source, free — Open-source 3D icons by Vijay Verma
- [LottieFiles Free](https://lottiefiles.com/): mixed - check each asset — Large animated library
- [IRA Design](https://iradesign.io/): MIT — Modular illustration builder by Creative Tim
- [Lukasz Adam](https://lukaszadam.com/illustrations): CC0 — Free miscellaneous vectors
- [absurd.design](https://absurd.design/): free with attribution (free tier) — Surreal line-art
- [Ouch! by Icons8](https://icons8.com/ouch): free with link — Vector & 3D illustrations
- [Doodle Ipsum](https://doodleipsum.com/): free (Blush license) — Doodle API by Blush
- [Shapefest](https://shapefest.com/): free for commercial use — Large 3D shape library
- [illlustrations.co](https://illlustrations.co/): open source, free — Open-source illustrations

## Iconify API (open CORS, no key)

```
GET /search?query=<term>&limit=<n>&prefixes=<p1,p2>
GET /<prefix>/<icon>.svg?color=<hex|currentColor>&height=<px>
GET /collections?prefixes=<p1,p2>   # name, author, license, count, samples per set
GET /collection?prefix=<p>          # all icon names in a set
Base: https://api.iconify.design
```

## Deep links

- Search results: https://icongems.kuige.me/?q=<term>  ·  Browse one set: https://icongems.kuige.me/?set=<id>

## Licensing

- No attribution: MIT, Apache-2.0, ISC, CC0 — most sets above
- Attribution required: CC BY 4.0 (Solar, Font Awesome 6 Free, Twemoji, Codicons)
- Illustrations: per-entry, see catalog. unDraw prohibits AI/ML training use.
- Always verify on the source site before shipping.
